signals.detail: OpenAPI 3.1.0 · Cloudflare Public Site API · 3 paths

approval_path.title: Use the published OpenAPI
approval_path.detail: Generate a client from the spec; treat it as your primary interface. Pair with OAuth where available.

approval_path.title: Find the developer signup
approval_path.detail: No standard OAuth discovery — most sites still have a developer-portal signup. Find the OAuth client registration page on their site.

approval_path.title: Publish your own agent identity
approval_path.detail: Generate an Ed25519 keypair, host a public key directory, sign your HTTP requests (Web Bot Auth), apply to Cloudflare's bots & agents directory if you cross their edge.

approval_path.title: Respect robots.txt and Content Signals
approval_path.detail: Even when you are an approved agent, honor the site's policy preferences. Cache them; refresh weekly.

recommended_next_steps: Publish /agents.txt declaring which agent protocols you support.
If you operate an agent, publish /.well-known/agent-card.json so others can discover it.
